author.name: Horace Chan
author.headline: Expert in applying AI in verification

text:
AI revolution in the business world is something like this:

You are in a car race, suddenly the race is changed to a plane race.  You have to upgrade your car to a plane while you are still racing

There are checkpoints along the race track that is now turned into a runway.  You get more upgrade points based on your ranking. There is a cliff at the end of the runway.

It doesn't matter if you are #1 at all the check points.  If you can't take off, you are out of the race
